description: This file implements the advanced process functions of the Slap Loam Broker Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) system. It primarily handles inter-process communication (IPC) calls via an LPC (lightweight process communication) mechanism, including processing asynchronous calls, object location, and other SLAP call types. The file contains detailed implementations of request handling, synchronization mechanisms, and memory management for inter-party messaging and object lookup.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboAsyncCallTaskLoco(ANSC_HANDLE hCallInfo)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous object location call in a separate task, handling IPC communication to locate objects across LPC parties, managing message buffers, and processing responses to determine success or failure.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboProcessCallAcqc(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Handles incoming IMCP SLAP calls of type 'acqc' by responding with 'invalid request type' as this is unsupported in this context.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboProcessCallRelc(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Handles 'relc' requests, also responding with 'invalid request type', indicating these call types are not supported.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboProcessCallLoco(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Main handler for 'loco' (object locate) requests. Manages cache lookup, broadcasting locate requests to other LPC parties if necessary, handles synchronization, and constructs the response with the located party's address if found.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboProcessCallDelo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Responds to 'delo' (delete object) requests with an unsupported request type error.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboProcessCallInvo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Responds to 'invo' (invoke object) requests with an unsupported request type error.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboProcessCallAcqo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Handles 'acqo' (object acquire) requests, returning 'invalid request type' as unsupported.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboProcessCallRelo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Handles 'relo' (release object) requests by returning 'invalid request type', indicating unsupported type.
